query:
UPDATE devices SET
                     last_seen = CASE WHEN status = 'revoked' THEN last_seen ELSE $2 END,
                     telemetry = CASE WHEN status = 'active' THEN $3 ELSE telemetry END,
                     telemetry_at = CASE WHEN status = 'active' THEN $2 ELSE telemetry_at END
                 WHERE id = $1
                 RETURNING status
